sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Atul Kumar Tiwari,Nitin Sharma Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Surendra Kumar Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
List revised.
No one has appeared on behalf of the applicant to press this application.
Mr. K.P. Pathak, learned AGA for the State is present.

The present application has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 517 of 2011,
under Sections 498A, 494, 504, 506 IPC, P.S. Merapur, District Farrukhabad with the prayer that in the event of arrest, applicant may be released on bail.
The fact of the case is that the counsel for the applicant has not appeared in the matter since filing of the case in the year 2011 goes to show that there is no apprehension of arrest.

sentences.text: Perusal of the order sheet goes to show that on 05.04.2021 list was revised but no one appears to argue the matter.
The record goes to show that an FIR was lodged in the year 2011, charge sheet has already been submitted in the matter.

The applicant has filed an application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. which was dismissed in the year 2017, after which he has filed present anticipatory bail application after availing all the remedies i.e. Application u/s 482 Cr.P.C., SLP and moving discharge application which was also rejected in the year 2020.

There being no interim order in any of the petition, the applicant has filed present anticipatory bail application which has not been argued since its filing which itself goes to show that there is apprehension of arrest and the conduct of the applicant shows that he has filed several cases in order to obtain a favourable order.

In order to make disposal of this application, it is relevant to mention Section 438 Cr.P.C., which is reproduced herein below:-
"438. Direction for grant of bail to person apprehending arrest.
(1) When any person has reason to believe that he may be arrested on an accusation of having committed a non- bailable offence, he may apply to the High Court or the Court of Session for a direction under this section; and that Court may, if it thinks fit,
direct that in the event of such arrest, he shall be released on bail.
